subject: Banking credentials and remit preferences for ClearPoint Logistics onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@clearpointlogistics.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: payables@clearpointlogistics.com
Date: Sat, 18 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor banking details for Redwood onboarding - ClearPoint Logistics

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for walking us through the onboarding checklist yesterday. Attached are the bank authorization letter (signed), our completed W-9, and a sample invoice CSV that includes the invoice reference format we use internally. Key details below for quick reference: 

- Bank: First Harbor Bank
- Account name: ClearPoint Logistics LLC
- Account type: Checking
- Routing (ACH): 122000246
- Account: 987654321
- Wire ABA: 122000246
- Remittance email: payables@clearpointlogistics.com
- Standard remit string: PO#[PO_NUMBER] | INV#[INVOICE_NUMBER]

Two quick asks: 1) Can you confirm whether we should include the full PO ID or the short PO label in the remit description for automatic matching? 2) Do you need a VOID check or is the signed bank letter sufficient for your finance team?

We can also accept a micro-deposit verification if that’s your preferred verification path — let us know and we’ll watch the account.

Attachments: ClearPoint_BankLetter_signed.pdf (PDF, 234KB), ClearPoint_W9.pdf (PDF, 120KB), sample_invoice_reference.csv (CSV, 2KB).

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Director of Finance Operations
ClearPoint Logistics
elena@clearpointlogistics.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@clearpointlogistics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 18 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor banking details for Redwood onboarding - ClearPoint Logistics

Elena —

Received, thank you. This is perfect to get started. Quick notes / next steps from our side: 

- For automated PO matching we need the full PO ID (the 10-character code we issue). Please use PO#[FULL_PO_ID] in the remit description. Short labels tend to mis-map when invoices bulk-ingest.
- The signed bank letter is acceptable for initial enrollment, but Finance requires either a micro-deposit verification OR a cleared voided check before first payout for amounts > $5k. For onboarding we typically run a single micro-deposit (>$0.01 and <$0.50) and ask you to confirm the amount.
- I’ve flagged this thread to Ben (payments team) to start portal enrollment and kick off the micro-deposit.
- Expected timeline: enrollment + micro-deposit initiation by EOD Monday; once you confirm the micro-deposit we can schedule the first remittance on the next pay-run.

Can you confirm you’ll watch for the micro-deposit and send us back the exact amount once it posts? Also please confirm whether any invoices will be sent to payables@clearpointlogistics.com or routed to a third-party AP provider.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead — Procurement
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (646) 333-1212

Marissa —

I’ve created the vendor record in the payments portal (Vendor ID: V-43890). I uploaded the signed bank letter and W-9 to the secure folder and set verification method to MICRODEPOSIT. Initiated the $0.12 test deposit at 08:30 PT. Expected posting window: 1–2 business days depending on receiving bank.
